DEF-009.apply: Gate (first turn-on in portal: Email & collaboration > Policies & rules > Threat policies > Preset security policies > Standard protection > Manage protection settings), then Set-EOPProtectionPolicyRule / Set-ATPProtectionPolicyRule -Identity 'Standard Preset Security Policy' and Enable-EOPProtectionPolicyRule / Enable-ATPProtectionPolicyRule

DEF-009.check: both rules State == 'Enabled' and RecipientDomainIs contains every accepted domain

tcm.note: S-02 not done; Microsoft365DSC equivalent: EXOEOPProtectionPolicyRule, EXOATPProtectionPolicyRule

DEF-009.verified: Connect-ExchangeOnline -AccessToken (app-only) on the test tenant; Get-Command shows the cmdlet and every parameter used here (EXO only exposes cmdlets the app's RBAC allows); the Get-* read returned the default object; no preset rules exist yet (count 0)
DEF-009.notes: The preset's rules and policies do not exist until the preset is turned on once in the Defender portal (Get-EOPProtectionPolicyRule and Get-ATPProtectionPolicyRule returned no rules on the test tenant), so the first turn-on is a gate; after it, the cmdlets below set recipients and state. Preset policies themselves cannot be edited, only their rules. SentToMemberOf needs mail-enabled groups; if the access groups are plain security groups, the pipeline must pass SentTo with the members instead. SPEC §23 asks every setting to exclude grp-break-glass where the product allows; for mail protection that weakens protection on the most sensitive accounts, so ExceptIfSentToMemberOf is left out: decision for the reviewer.
